verdict.rationale: The docs only show runs started from your own backend code via `task.trigger()` with the payload, plus an authenticated management API. A developer would have to build and host their own HTTP endpoint that calls trigger(). A user's report of needing a proxy to trigger from the frontend points the same way. missing for 10: a first-party custom/inbound webhook URL feature, docs on mapping an HTTP request payload to a run, webhook authentication/verification, independent corroboration.
